purpose: List the facts a person stated about their own work. The model translates; the backend decides what holds.

words.description: The person's speech, sent as a JSON string so it stays data.

skills.description: Catalog skill slugs the model may credit.

asked.description: The slot the person was asked about.

input_example.words: Old call lost payments, I proposed a Kafka queue myself, by the end of the quarter not one was lost.

text_en.description: One English sentence, at most 20 words.

mine.description: The person did it, not the team.

q: I proposed a Kafka queue myself

facts.text_en: Zero lost payments by quarter end

backend_checks: The words are kept before the model is asked, and stay if it fails (503 unavailable, 429 over budget).
Every fragment in q is an exact substring of the words, else the fact is dropped.
Every figure is written in one of its fragments, as digits (grouped thousands allowed) or as a number in words, else the fact is dropped.
Skills not in the catalog are dropped; at most 3 a fact. Technologies at most 8, 40 characters each.
An unknown kind, or an answer that is not this JSON, is dropped or answered as unavailable, never guessed.
A fact repeating a live fact of the story is dropped; at most 12 claims a call.
Place fills only empty fields; the slot heard and 'nothing more' are decided by code, not by the model.
The same spec, model and input are answered from the memo and cost nothing; each person has a daily token budget.
